articles.title: How a Luxury Brand Snagged the Sport with a 400% Surge
articles.subtitle: Check out this insight on a luxury brand!
articles.body:
Welcome to a masterclass in bold market moves: ROLEX's sponsoring 21-year-old Padel phenom Arturo Coello and moving to whole new distribution model. 🎾⌚While most luxury brands wait for a sport to reach country club maturity, ROLEX is out front—injecting fresh energy and backing the next wave of global culture before it becomes the status quo. For over 120 years, they've been more than trendsetters; they’re market validators, turning bold bets into new frontiers. 𝘛𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘴 𝘱𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘺𝘣𝘰𝘰𝘬: 𝘴𝘱𝘰𝘵 𝘮𝘰𝘮𝘦𝘯𝘵𝘶𝘮 𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘭𝘺, 𝘥𝘰𝘶𝘣𝘭𝘦 𝘥𝘰𝘸𝘯, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘪𝘯𝘷𝘪𝘵𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘸𝘰𝘳𝘭𝘥 𝘵𝘰 𝘳𝘪𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘺𝘰𝘶.

Danielle Savino with Fractional CRO, LLC latest blog, Brand Goldmine or Sinkhole, pulls back the curtain on what separates brands that lead from those that follow—and why partnership, vision, and decisive action set the pace.✋🏻 🛑 𝐅𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐂𝐄𝐎, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐄𝐱𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩, winning brands don’t wait on the sidelines—they shape the future with intention and bold partnership 🤝 read on to learn how you can:✴️ 𝐂𝐥𝐚𝐢𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐄𝐚𝐫𝐥𝐲-𝐌𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐄𝐝𝐠𝐞 🛫 by seizing the moment, before everyone else sees it, and reshape the playing field to accelerate real growth.✴️ 𝐌𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐁𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐁𝐞𝐭𝐬 ♠️ 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝘣𝘦𝘤𝘢𝘶𝘴𝘦 acting on fast-emerging opportunities isn’t just daring; it’s the strategic blueprint for compounding results year after year.✴️ 𝐄𝐥𝐞𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐋𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐜𝐲 🆙 𝐓𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 by aligning with rising icons and owning the story, great brands don’t just ride cultural 🌊—they help create them, deepening loyalty across generations.𝑮𝒓𝒂𝒃 🥡 𝑮𝒐 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝑪𝑬𝑶𝒔 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝑭𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅𝒆𝒓𝒔: If you’re aiming for sustainable, game-changing growth, it’s time to align with emerging movements 𝘣𝘦𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘸𝘰𝘳𝘭𝘥 𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘤𝘩𝘦𝘴 𝘰𝘯 (🤫 our little secret). 𝐋𝐄𝐓'𝐒 𝐋𝐄𝐀𝐃 𝐆𝐑𝐎𝐖𝐓𝐇 𝐓𝐎𝐆𝐄𝐓𝐇𝐄𝐑—because momentum rewards those who move first.𝐃𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐛𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐰 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐡𝐨𝐰 𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐝, 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐜 𝐦𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐧 𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐮𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐩𝐩𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐚𝐝𝐯𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐞. 👇

articles.title: Sgt. Clean Car Wash Scholarship
articles.subtitle: Check out this great opportunity for graduating students!
articles.body:
Sgt. Clean Car Wash is recognizing 8 students, with 4 being internal team members, with a $1,000 scholarship. This scholarship awards eight (8) one-time scholarships of $1,000 each to qualifying students in Medina, Portage, Cuyahoga, Stark, or Summit County to be applied toward school tuition and fees in support of vocational trades, business, and or entrepreneurship.
How to Apply & Deadline: Submit an essay no longer than 300 words answering, “What does servant leadership mean to you? How will you show servant leadership in your life?” Submissions must be completed online at Sgtclean.com/scholarship by April 30, 2026.
Awards and Disbursement: All winners will be notified by May 12, 2026. Winners will be invited to a group luncheon with our Senior Executive Team for a check presentation. Funds will then be disbursed directly to the educational institution in the student’s name. Winners will have the opportunity to ask leadership and business questions over lunch.
Criteria: Must be a citizen, national, or legal permanent resident of the U.S. Must be a current (or recently graduated) high school senior planning to enroll full-time at an accredited U.S. vocational, junior college, or four-year college/university. Completed online application in full, submitted by the deadline.
